description: Make a little world with a sentence.
thought: What would you like to see here?
fatal: This world couldn’t open. Try opening it again.
failed: That didn’t work this time. Try another sentence or try again.
fixtureFailed: For the demo, send “{ball}” or choose pictures and send “{assets}”.
expired: Your unsent sentence expired. You can write a new one.
sending: Your previous sentence is still sending.
offline: Your sentence is saved on this device. It will send when you’re back online.
retryLater: Couldn’t connect. Try again in a moment.
waitTaps: Let these taps save before tapping again.
offlineTaps: Your taps are saved here and will sync when you reconnect.
staleTap: The world has changed. Tap the object in the new scene.
tapFailed: That tap didn’t work. You can keep playing.
libraryDetail: Choose free pictures or upload a drawing.
aiNote: {provider} draws new pictures. Existing pictures can be reused when you change a movement.
aiMissing: Set up {provider} on the server to draw new pictures.
libraryNote: Free pictures by Kenney (CC0). Your uploads stay on this server in this mode.
artHelp: The pictures you choose go with your next sentence.
uploadInfo: Your original is saved. A transparent image works well as a character. A drawing on paper can fill a whole page.
fileRules: Static PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
consent: Allow the selected uploaded drawings to be sent to {provider} as reference images
maxAssets: Choose up to 16 pictures at a time.
saved: Your artwork is saved and selected. Write a sentence to use it.
uploadFailed: Couldn’t save this drawing. Check the file and try again.
retentionNote: Inputs, creations and interactions. Real sessions are kept for three months. The current work and the files it needs are kept for recovery.
imageResponse: View original image response with encoded data ↗
quota: The OpenAI credits for this app have run out. Ask the person who runs it to check the balance.
providerAccess: This app can’t access the selected OpenAI model. Ask the person who runs it to check the settings.
